bibliography.title: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation

sections.title: Appendix A. Use of Large Language Models

abstract_sentences.text: What does it mean to understand the world?

evidence.anchor: What does it mean to understand the world?

abstract_sentences.text: Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space.

evidence.anchor: accurate future prediction in latent or observation space

abstract_sentences.text: Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired.

evidence.anchor: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories

abstract_sentences.text: Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations.

We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model.

evidence.anchor: induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought

abstract_sentences.text: In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena.

evidence.anchor: learned primitives can be systematically recombined

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.

evidence.anchor: reusable across instances, compositional across novel situations

final_judgment.single_storyline: [p. 2–5, §§1–3] L2T 将理解界定为从 observation pair 构造可执行、可复用、可组合的 latent program；NEO 用 shared executor、MDL 和 grounding 实现它。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: [p. 2–9, Figures 1–7; Tables 1–3] 保留问题定义、support-to-query transfer、NEO 方程、主结果、grounding/MDL 消融与限制。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: [p. 13–41, Appendices B–F] 伪代码、metric definitions、split、全表、cost、dataset sizes、rollouts 与 hyperparameters 均移入附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: [p. 3, §2; p. 6, §5.1] support pair 提取 program、query pair 执行同一 program，使 explanation 成为可检验 transfer criterion。
final_judgment.largest_gap: [p. 7, §5.4; p. 9, §6] controlled synthetic oracle evidence、three-run means 与 appendix-dependent details 未证明 human/causal semantics；Arithmetic long-horizon 还依赖 search。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: [p. 2–3, §§1–2] 若声称学到解释而非预测，应使用由第一实例抽取表示、在第二实例执行的 transfer test，并让模型部件与该 test 对应。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: [p. 9, §6] 当 observation 无法辨识机制、query 不共享机制，或目标只能以预测定义时，support-to-query transfer 不能单独识别解释性。
